categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: automotive parts manufacturing and display fixtures & household products. The automotive segment focuses on safety components such as airbag inflator housings, pretensioner seatbelt components, steering system modules, and cooling parts for electric vehicles and servers. The display segment produces various types of display racks, hangers, and fixtures mainly for large retail chains in Europe, America, and Asia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include metal forming, stamping, cold and hot metal tube processing, assembly, and automated production and inspection systems. The company designs and manufactures specialized automated production and measurement equipment to ensure high precision and quality. It also employs CAE simulation for process development and continuously innovates in precision machining, forging, and surface treatment technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global top-tier automotive safety system manufacturers and large multinational retail chains in Europe, America, and Asia. The automotive parts serve OEMs focusing on safety airbags, seatbelts, steering, and cooling systems, while the display products cater to apparel, food, toy, sports, and footwear retail sectors. The company maintains long-term relationships with these customers and collaborates closely on product development.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing and sales facilities in Taiwan, China (Zhejiang and Huzhou), Poland, and Germany. Its sales markets span Asia, America, and Europe, with significant exports to these regions. The company also has subsidiaries and investment holdings in Hong Kong and Germany to support global operations and market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive and retail display supply chains, manufacturing key components and assemblies. It sources raw materials such as seamless steel tubes from certified suppliers and provides integrated production services including design, forming, assembly, and quality inspection. It acts as a system integrator and solution provider to downstream OEMs and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing 'thermal management' solutions for automotive and server cooling applications, enhancing smart manufacturing and automation (Industry 4.0), and expanding high value-added product lines. R&D focuses on safety components, heat dissipation parts, and process innovation such as automated measurement and feedback systems. The company also pursues cross-industry collaborations and patent development to secure future growth drivers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of automotive safety components and display fixtures. The company also earns income from its subsidiaries and investments. It emphasizes long-term contracts with global OEMs and retail chains, leveraging customized product development and integrated manufacturing services to maintain stable revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global automotive safety parts manufacturers and display fixture producers. It holds a competitive position due to its advanced manufacturing capabilities, quality certifications (ISO/TS standards), and close customer partnerships. The company differentiates itself by integrating automated production lines and rapid product development, enabling it to meet stringent quality and delivery requirements in a competitive market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$5.04 billion with a net profit of NT$731 million, representing a 3% revenue growth and over 40% net profit increase year-over-year. The company has shown steady growth with expanding capital and equity, supported by investments in overseas production bases. It maintains a strong financial position with increasing retained earnings and capital reserves.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision manufacturing, stringent quality control, and rapid product development cycles as its core value propositions. Its ability to design and produce automated production and inspection equipment internally allows for superior product quality and cost control. The focus on thermal management and safety innovation, combined with global production footprint and customer intimacy, differentiates it from competitors and supports sustainable growth.
